failure_modes.recovery: List projects via studio_project_list and use a returned id.
failure_modes.when: the project id does not exist in your scope

description: Rename a project, change its status, or replace its thumbnail on a project you own — send thumbnail_data_url, never thumbnail_key, which is server-owned and computed by this door the same way studio_project_create does. status here is UI-summary-only by design: it never gates render or generation, which are tracked separately by the export job row and the composition document's own scene status. Free. NOT_FOUND when the id is outside your scope — list first with studio_project_list.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

id.description: The studio project id to update (studio_project_list shows them).

thumbnail_data_url.description: Data URL (data:image/...) of the project thumbnail — the door externalizes it into a content-addressed R2 key through the media hygiene kit (magic bytes decide the type; SVG refuses). Never send thumbnail_key directly; it is server-owned and computed from this field. Omit to leave the thumbnail unset/unchanged.

name: studio_project_update
